WALL-CLOCK IS EXPLICITLY NOT CLAIMED STABLE and is not graded: the engine's own `used` ranged 0.797-1.219 s for .tools and 0.547-1.094 s for org/modules/heatmap, and the pre-change baseline (5.25 s / 4.234 s) was itself taken warm -- W1-S1 measured the same unscoped walk at 6.2-11.7 s cold.
